body:
Nothing prevent us to dot it. The other connectors (that I looked) don't do validation on user input, they pass the results to the helper. But in the `connectRange` case we need to do some validations on it to be able to check the given value on boundaries.

IMO we should not trust the user inputs. We should probably do some validation in the connector to avoid to throw an error in the helper if the value is not supported (see [`valToNumber`](https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-helper-js/blob/7275a756510f5d7df460ae99cb88af6c2e617424/src/functions/valToNumber.js)).
